nativeZh: prep. 为, 因为, 至于
[计] DOS批处理命令:对一组参数重复执行指定的命令

senses.en: In the most general sense, indicating that in consideration of, in view of, or with reference to, which anything is done or takes place.
senses.zh: 最一般的意义上,表示在考虑,考虑,或参考哪些事情已经发生或发生了.

senses.en: Indicating the antecedent cause or occasion of an action; the motive or inducement accompanying and prompting to an act or state; the reason of anything; that on account of which a thing is or is done.
senses.zh: 说明某一行为或国家的先天原因或场合;行为或国家的动机或诱因;任何事物的理由;正在或正在为之采取行动的理由。

senses.en: Indicating the remoter and indirect object of an act; the end or final cause with reference to which anything is, acts, serves, or is done.
senses.zh: 指明某一行为的间接和间接目标;指任何事物、行为、服务或行为最终或最终原因。

senses.en: Indicating that in favor of which, or in promoting which, anything is, or is done; hence, in behalf of; in favor of; on the side of; -- opposed to against.
senses.zh: 说明哪些人正在做或正在促进什么;因此,代表哪些人;哪些人赞成哪些人;哪些人在哪些方面;反对哪些人。

senses.en: Indicating that toward which the action of anything is directed, or the point toward which motion is made; /ntending to go to.
senses.zh: 说明任何行动所针对的目标,或提出动议的要点;/不准备去。

senses.en: Indicating that on place of or instead of which anything acts or serves, or that to which a substitute, an equivalent, a compensation, or the like, is offered or made; instead of, or place of.
senses.zh: 说明任何行为或服务的地点或代替之处,或提供或提供替代物、等价物、补偿或类似的补偿;而不是、或地点。

senses.en: Indicating that in the character of or as being which anything is regarded or treated; to be, or as being.
senses.zh: 说明其性质或作为任何事物被看待或对待的方面;是,或作为。

senses.en: Indicating that instead of which something else controls in the performing of an action, or that in spite of which anything is done, occurs, or is; hence, equivalent to notwithstanding, in spite of; -- generally followed by all, aught, anything, etc.
senses.zh: 表明在采取行动时,与其控制其他行为,或不顾一切,发生,或正在发生;因此,与尽管如此,尽管如此; -- -- 通常,随后是一切,一无所有,任何东西,等等。

senses.en: Indicating the space or time through which an action or state extends; hence, during; in or through the space or time of.
senses.zh: 说明某一行动或状态延伸的空间或时间;因此,在行动或状态期间;在行动或状态的空间或时间内或经过。

senses.en: Indicating that in prevention of which, or through fear of which, anything is done.
senses.zh: 说明在预防方面,或由于对预防的恐惧,已经做了任何事情。

senses.en: Because; by reason that; for that; indicating, in Old English, the reason of anything.
senses.zh: 因为,因为那个原因,因为那个原因;用旧英语表示一切的原因.

senses.en: Since; because; introducing a reason of something before advanced, a cause, motive, explanation, justification, or the like, of an action related or a statement made. It is logically nearly equivalent to since, or because, but connects less closely, and is sometimes used as a very general introduction to something suggested by what has gone before.
senses.zh: 因为；由于。用来为前面提出的看法或所述行为引出原因、动机、解释或依据。其逻辑意义接近since或because，但与前文的连接较松，有时只是一般地引出由前文联想到的说明。

senses.en: One who takes, or that which is said on, the affrimative side; that which is said in favor of some one or something; -- the antithesis of against, and commonly used in connection with it.
senses.zh: 取或言之者,谓之附方;言之者,指之于某方或某物;曰:逆者,并与之相通也.
